gui.minisort.deposit_matching.descriptio: Puts away every stack of an item this container already holds. Your hotbar stays put.
gui.minisort.deposit_all.description: Puts away your whole main inventory. Your hotbar stays put.
gui.minisort.retrieve_matching.descripti: Takes every stack of an item you already carry.
gui.minisort.retrieve_all.description: Takes everything that fits, filling your main inventory before your hotbar.
gui.minisort.sort_container.description: Merges partial stacks and orders the container.
gui.minisort.sort_inventory.description: Orders your main inventory. Your hotbar stays put.
gui.minisort.sort_shortcut: Middle-click a slot or press %s to sort its side
gui.minisort.sort_shortcut.mouse: Middle-click a slot to sort its side
minisort.config.client.info: Three buttons sit beside chests, barrels, shulker boxes, dispensers, droppers, and hoppers. Sort tidies the container, Deposit moves in what it already holds, and Retrieve takes out what you already carry.
minisort.config.sorting.info: Pick how the sort button orders a container. This is your own choice; everyone on a server can pick a different mode.
minisort.config.sort_mode.info: Creative Inventory matches the creative tabs, tab by tab. Registry ID groups items by mod and then by name.
minisort.config.sort_mode.creative.info: The order of the creative inventory's tabs: building blocks first, then colored and natural blocks, tools, combat gear, food, and ingredients. Items that aren't on a tab sit next to related items.
minisort.config.sort_mode.registry_id.in: Alphabetical by item ID, so items from the same mod stay together.
minisort.config.buttons.info: Move the buttons if another mod draws something in the same spot. Positions count from the container screen's top-left corner.
minisort.config.buttons.position.info: Counted in screen pixels from the container screen's top-left corner. The default column sits just right of a chest.
minisort.config.common.info: When the stack in your hand runs out, the next matching stack from your inventory moves in. These settings come from the server.
minisort.config.refill.info: Refill reacts to placing, eating, throwing, and breaking. Dropping an item or putting on armor leaves your hand empty.
minisort.config.refill_blocks.info: Placing the last block pulls in another stack of the exact same block.
minisort.config.refill_tools.info: A broken tool is replaced by the same tool with the same enchantments and name. Only durability may differ.
minisort.config.refill_consumables.info: Finishing the last food item or drink pulls in another matching stack.
minisort.config.refill_generic_use_items: Ender pearls, snowballs, bone meal, spawn eggs, fireworks, and other items used with a right-click.
minisort.config.inventory.info: Refill looks in your hotbar and main inventory. It never takes from armor slots, shulker boxes, bundles, or open containers.
minisort.config.search_hotbar_first.info: Take the replacement from another hotbar slot before the main inventory. Turn off to keep your hotbar layout intact.
minisort.config.hint: Hover a setting to see what it changes.
